AREAD001.DAT:7:2.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:2.intent: Asking if following the path leads to mainland, checking with Poko
AREAD001.DAT:7:2.t: Voce quer dizer que, seguindo esse caminho, chegamos ao continente?

AREAD001.DAT:7:7.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:7.intent: Personagem ri e avisa que vão se meter em apuros se o sol se pôr antes de alcançar terra
AREAD001.DAT:7:7.risk_notes: Encurtado conforme revisão humana; tom irônico preservado no 'heh heh' e na construção da frase.
AREAD001.DAT:7:7.t: [14][02][02]"Heh heh...[02]Ela diz que apanhamos[01]feio se o sol baixar[02]antes de chegar[01]em terra firme."

AREAD001.DAT:7:14.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:14.intent: Acknowledging they can't go further today

AREAD001.DAT:7:15.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:15.intent: Expressing frustration at being stuck until morning
AREAD001.DAT:7:15.t: [0C][02][14][C2]@"Droga! Escuro demais[01]pra ver o caminho.[02]Parece que ficamos[01]aqui ate amanha."

AREAD001.DAT:7:16.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:16.intent: Suggesting they stop and wait for morning
AREAD001.DAT:7:16.t: [0C][02][14][C4]@"Escuro demais. Vamos[01]parar aqui e esperar[01]ate amanha."

AREAD001.DAT:7:17.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:17.intent: Relaying message that it's too dark to continue
AREAD001.DAT:7:17.t: [0C][02][14][C5]@"[04][05] me diz..."[02][14][86]E"Escuro demais pra[01]continuar -- parece[01]que ficamos aqui."

AREAD001.DAT:7:18.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:18.intent: Wondering how much further they need to go

AREAD001.DAT:7:19.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:19.intent: Complaining about wasting time sitting around

AREAD001.DAT:7:21.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:21.intent: Conceding the other person is right

AREAD001.DAT:7:24.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:24.intent: Lamenting they should have kept going through the night
AREAD001.DAT:7:24.t: [0C][05][14][09][04]"Nao deveriamos ter[01]parado![02]Deveriamos ter[01]continuado a noite[01]toda,[02]por mais arriscado[01]que fosse!"

AREAD001.DAT:7:25.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:25.intent: Apologizing and blaming themselves for suggesting they rest
AREAD001.DAT:7:25.t: [0C][06][14][8A]A"Me desculpe, [04][02].[01]A culpa e minha...[02]Se eu nao tivesse[01]sugerido que[01]descansassemos..."

AREAD001.DAT:7:28.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:28.intent: Urging others to do as told

AREAD001.DAT:7:31.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:31.intent: Explaining geographically where they are relative to mainland
AREAD001.DAT:7:31.t: [0C][05][14][C4]@"Pelo terreno, eu diria[01]que e aqui que as[02]planicies se ligam[01]ao continente."

AREAD001.DAT:7:32.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:32.intent: Saying they can't go this way either
AREAD001.DAT:7:32.t: [0C][05][14][C4]@"Nao adianta...[02]Tambem nao da pra[01]ir por aqui."

AREAD001.DAT:7:34.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:34.intent: Explaining they're stuck until the tide changes
AREAD001.DAT:7:34.t: [0C][05][14][04][03]"Ate a mare mudar[01]e as planicies[01]voltarem...[02]Ficamos presos aqui."

AREAD001.DAT:7:35.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:35.intent: Questioning how the other can be so calm

AREAD001.DAT:7:38.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:38.intent: Telling someone to calm down and that they'll get out

AREAD001.DAT:7:42.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:42.intent: Saying things will work out despite the unexpected situation
AREAD001.DAT:7:42.t: [14][07][01]"Bom, nao era bem[01]isso que a gente[02]esperava, mas...[02][14][01][01]Tenho certeza que[01]tudo vai dar certo[01]no final."

AREAD001.DAT:7:47.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:47.intent: Asking to join the exploration of the island

AREAD001.DAT:7:50.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:50.intent: Telling someone to calm down and get a hold of themselves

AREAD001.DAT:7:51.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:51.intent: Reminding someone they're supposed to be the leader

AREAD001.DAT:7:53.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:53.intent: Referencing Pabpab saying and applying it as a lesson
AREAD001.DAT:7:53.risk_notes: 'Pretty kitty' is a term of endearment — translated loosely to keep tone; Pukapuka kept as-is (cultural term).
AREAD001.DAT:7:53.t: [0C][03][14][86]E"Lembra o que o[01]Pabpab disse?[02]Pukapuka...O que for,[01]sera...[02]Uma boa licao pra[01]aprender, gatinha[01]linda..."[02][14][C5]@"De fato."

AREAD001.DAT:7:55.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:55.intent: Saying they were about to go look for food

AREAD001.DAT:7:57.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:57.intent: Noting there are worse places to be stuck
AREAD001.DAT:7:57.t: [14][06][05]"Bom, ja fui parar[01]em lugar pior do[01]que esse."[02][14]E

AREAD001.DAT:7:59.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:59.intent: Wondering if they can fish nearby
AREAD001.DAT:7:59.t: [14][0E][01]"Isso quer dizer que[01]da pra pescar[01]por aqui... Ne?"

AREAD001.DAT:7:60.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:60.intent: Asking if the person managed to catch anything

AREAD001.DAT:7:61.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:61.intent: Saying they don't need to worry about food

AREAD001.DAT:7:62.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:62.intent: Suggesting they go back and tell everyone what they found
AREAD001.DAT:7:62.t: [0C][05][14][01][01]"Vamos voltar e contar[01]pra todo mundo o[01]que achamos."

AREAD001.DAT:7:78.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:78.intent: Apologizing for panicking when they thought they were trapped
AREAD001.DAT:7:78.t: [0C][06][14][C2]@"Que bom...[02]Desculpe, [04][01].[01]Nao sei o que[01]deu em mim...[02]E que...Quando pensei[01]que estavamos[01]presos,[02]eu so...Nao sei,[01]entrei em panico..."

AREAD001.DAT:7:79.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:79.intent: Telling someone not to worry and to be patient
AREAD001.DAT:7:79.t: [0C][05][14][01][01]"Nao se preocupe, [04][02].[01]So precisamos ter[01]paciencia, so isso."

AREAD001.DAT:7:81.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:81.intent: Announcing they're going fishing and will be back soon

AREAD001.DAT:7:82.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:82.intent: Murmuring the 'what will be will be' phrase to themselves

AREAD001.DAT:7:90.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:90.intent: Reflecting that they always thought the two would get married; feeling brotherly closeness
AREAD001.DAT:7:90.t: [14][87]A"Sempre achei que[01]eles iam se casar[01]um dia...[02][14][81]AEle e como um[01]irmao pra mim..."

AREAD001.DAT:7:91.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:91.intent: Realizing she admires him more than loves him romantically
AREAD001.DAT:7:91.t: [14][C1]@"Acho que eu...[01]o admiro mais do[01]que o amo..."

AREAD001.DAT:7:92.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:92.intent: Listing positive traits of the person
AREAD001.DAT:7:92.t: [14][C1]@"Ele e forte...[01]Nao tem nada que[02]ele nao consiga...[01]E engracado..."

AREAD001.DAT:7:101.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:101.intent: Pointing out the tide is changing

AREAD001.DAT:7:102.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:102.intent: Saying the tide is going out and suggesting they go look

AREAD001.DAT:7:106.speaker: unknown
AREAD001.DAT:7:106.intent: Saying 'I told you so' about being patient
AREAD001.DAT:7:106.t: [14][06][05]"Ta vendo? Eu disse[01]que so precisavamos[01]ter paciencia."[02][14]E

AREAD001.DAT:7:113.speaker: system
AREAD001.DAT:7:113.intent: Environmental message asking players to keep fishing spots clean
AREAD001.DAT:7:113.t: Mantenha os locais de[01]pesca limpos! Lembre-se[01]de recolher seu lixo!
